treatment_summary: The patient has high cardiovascular risk due to diabetes, hypertension, obesity and markedly elevated LDL‑C. NICE recommends a high‑intensity statin (atorvastatin 80 mg) and low‑dose aspirin for primary ASCVD prevention, plus an SGLT2‑inhibitor (dapagliflozin 10 mg) for renal and cardiovascular protection. Blood pressure remains uncontrolled on three agents; a low‑dose beta‑blocker (bisoprolol) is added with careful titration. Existing antihypertensives, ACE‑I and metformin are continued, pending renal function verification. Monitoring includes lipid profile, renal function, electrolytes, potassium, liver enzymes, HbA1c and blood pressure at specified intervals. Lifestyle advice (diet, weight loss, exercise, smoking/alcohol moderation) is also recommended.
